शौष्कल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
 1. Eating fish and flesh.
 2. A vender of flesh.
 n.
(-लं) The price of dried-meat.
 E. शुष्कली dried flesh, aff. अण् ।
सौशील्य n. (-लं) Excellence of disposition, good morals.

. A
part of a drama.
 4. Lightness, fleetness, suppleness.
 5. Cleverness.
E. सुष्ठु excellent, &c., and अण् aff.
सौस्नातिक m. (-कः) One who asks whether an ablution has been auspicious.
